meta.note: Ten ideas, each with its own reason it might work, against a Random control. Intraday ideas: new trades 9:35 AM–3:00 PM, one at a time, out by target or stop (the same size, 1:1) or 3:55. Multi-day ideas (RSI(2) swing, Turn of the month) hold for days on real 3x ETF closing prices. 3x ETFs, $100 per trade, $0.005 per share each way

groups.name: Opening range breakout
groups.desc: Break of the first 15 minutes' high/low · why: big players pushing through where overnight orders were absorbed

groups.name: Gap fill
groups.desc: Gap of 0.30%+ at the open, bet it moves back toward yesterday's close · why: thin pre-market overreactions

groups.name: VWAP snap-back
groups.desc: 0.40%+ from VWAP (10:30–2:30), bet on a move back · why: fund execution algorithms lean against stretched prices

groups.name: Lunch fade
groups.desc: 15-minute move of 0.20%+ at lunch (11:30–1:30), fade it · why: thin midday trading, little real information

groups.name: Power hour breakout
groups.desc: At the day's high/low at 3:00, ride it to the close · why: closing flows push the same way

groups.name: Volume spike fade
groups.desc: 1-minute bar with 4× normal volume and a 0.15%+ move, fade it · why: one big order or a stop cascade tends to give back

groups.name: SPY–QQQ snap-back
groups.desc: QQQ 0.35%+ ahead of or behind SPY since the open, bet the gap closes · why: they move together ~90% of the time

groups.name: Trend day
groups.desc: 0.60%+ by 10:30 and one side of VWAP the whole time, ride it · why: strong one-way opens often keep going all day

groups.name: RSI(2) swing (days)
groups.desc: Daily RSI(2) under 10 above the 200-day average, buy; sell above the 5-day average · why: dips in uptrends bounce within days

models.rule: Sell when the close beats its 5-day average, or after 3 days
Sell when the close beats its 5-day average, or after 5 days
Sell when the close beats its 5-day average, or after 10 days

groups.name: Turn of the month (days)
groups.desc: Buy 2 trading days before month end, hold into the new month · why: pension, payroll and rebalancing money arrives

models.rule: Sell on trading day 1 of the new month
Sell on trading day 3 of the new month
Sell on trading day 5 of the new month

groups.name: Random control
groups.desc: Random minutes 9:35–3:00, coin flip for direction, same exits · the yardstick to beat
